ads.name: Marketing touches (ads)
ads.description: Marketing touchpoints and conversions. A touch after a conversion cannot have caused it.

tables.name: conversions
tables.grain: one row per conversion (one per user here)

ads.setup: CREATE TABLE touches (user_id int, touched_at timestamp, channel text); INSERT INTO touches VALUES (1,'2026-03-01 10:00','email'),(1,'2026-03-03 10:00','paid_search'),(2,'2026-03-02 10:00','social'),(3,'2026-03-01 10:00','paid_search'),(3,'2026-03-06 10:00','email'),(5,'2026-03-02 10:00','email'); CREATE TABLE conversions (user_id int, converted_at timestamp, revenue numeric(10,2)); INSERT INTO conversions VALUES (1,'2026-03-05 10:00',100),(2,'2026-03-04 10:00',50),(3,'2026-03-05 10:00',80),(4,'2026-03-07 10:00',40);

problems.title: Last-touch revenue
problems.prompt:
Credit each conversion to the channel of the user's LAST touch at or before the conversion time (last-touch attribution). Conversions with no prior touch are credited to `direct`.

Report conversions and revenue per channel, sorted by revenue (highest first), then channel.
problems.solution:
WITH credited AS (
  SELECT c.user_id, c.revenue,
         (SELECT t.channel FROM touches t
          WHERE t.user_id = c.user_id AND t.touched_at <= c.converted_at
          ORDER BY t.touched_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS channel
  FROM conversions c
)
SELECT COALESCE(channel, 'direct') AS channel, COUNT(*) AS conversions, SUM(revenue) AS revenue
FROM credited GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC, channel;

tests.name: Touch at the exact conversion time
tests.why: "At or before" includes the same instant.
tests.patch: INSERT INTO touches VALUES (6,'2026-03-08 10:00','social'); INSERT INTO conversions VALUES (6,'2026-03-08 10:00',30);

hints: Which touches are even eligible to receive credit for a conversion?
For each conversion, find the latest eligible touch; users with none need a default.
Correlated subquery (or LATERAL) with touched_at <= converted_at ORDER BY touched_at DESC LIMIT 1, then COALESCE(channel, 'direct')
problems.explain: Only touches before the conversion can be credited; a later email to user 3 is irrelevant. COALESCE gives unattributed conversions an explicit bucket so revenue still adds up.

reasoning.q: User 3 converted on Mar 5 and received an email on Mar 6. Which channel gets the credit?
reasoning.why: A touch after the conversion cannot have influenced it.

clarifications.q: What if a user converted with no touches?
